title: Boxing tracker session (detector output)
description: Output of analysis/detector.py for one recorded session. All *_s times are seconds relative to the first raw sample, on the device clock (single sensor) or on the aligned session clock (two sensors: each device clock is mapped to host time with the offset/drift recorded in session.devices[].clock, and t = 0 is the earliest aligned first sample): t = (device_time_us - device_time_us[0]) / 1e6 (unwrap uint32 rollover if the firmware uses a 32-bit µs counter). Labels CSV times (host_time_s) are aligned by subtracting the raw CSV's first host_time_s. schema_version follows semver: MAJOR = breaking change, MINOR = additive optional fields, PATCH = docs only. Consumers accept any 1.x.y. 1.1.0 (additive): session.devices[] and punches[].device_id for one sensor inside each hand wrap; 1.0.0 files remain valid.

schema_version.description: Schema version this file conforms to. Current: 1.1.0 (1.0.0 files remain valid; consumers accept any 1.x).

start_time_iso.description: Wall-clock time of the first raw sample, ISO 8601 with offset.

accel_range_g.description: Full-scale accel range, e.g. 16 for LSM6DS3TR-C at ±16 g.

hand_worn.description: Wrist the device is worn on, if known. null for two-sensor sessions (see devices).

hand.description: Which hand wears the sensor (inside the hand wrap). null for two-sensor sessions (see devices).

stance.description: Orthodox = left hand leads. With hand + stance, hand_worn (L/R) follows.

calibration.description: Optional guard-pose calibration captured at session start.

guard_gravity_g.description: Mean accel vector (g, sensor frame) while holding guard.

forward_axis.description: Unit vector (sensor frame) of the punching direction.

devices.description: Since 1.1.0. One entry per sensor (one inside each hand wrap). Single-sensor sessions have one entry. Absent in 1.0.0 files.

device_id.description: Stable device id (e.g. advertised name suffix or BLE address).

hand.description: Hand role set at pairing (stored on the device).

wrist.description: Left/right wrist; follows from hand + stance.

clock.description: Clock alignment applied to this device's timestamps: host_time_s = a + (1 + skew_ppm*1e-6) * device_time_s.

source.description: rtt (connection-time + periodic time-sync exchanges), packet (notification arrival lower envelope), raw_host_time (logger anchor, offset only) or device (single sensor, no alignment).

offset_s.description: Start of this device's first sample on the session timeline (s).

skew_ppm.description: Estimated device clock drift vs host (ppm). Positive: the device clock runs slow relative to host (host advances faster per device second).

residual_ms.description: RMS residual of the clock fit (ms).

window_ms.description: Half-width of the feature window around the peak (e.g. 150 → ±150 ms).

index.description: 0-based. Rounds and rests share one index sequence in time order.

type.description: Event type (v1). Strikes: jab, cross, lead_hook, rear_hook, lead_uppercut, rear_uppercut, overhand, spinning_backfist, unknown. NON-STRIKE, low-confidence events, excluded from every punch/strike statistic in summary: kick_or_body_movement (a hand-wrap sensor cannot measure kicks; this is body motion that looks like one) and clinch (a DURATION event: t_start_s..t_end_s spans the clinch, t_peak_s is its strongest sample, speed_mps_est null).

peak_g.description: Peak |a| - 1 g in the window (g). A LOWER BOUND when saturated is true. This is acceleration, not force or power.

speed_mps_est.description: Heuristic hand-speed estimate from integrating accel; not ground truth.

gyro_int_dps_s.description: Integral of gyro x/y/z over the window, in degrees (dps·s).

saturated.description: True if any accel axis clipped inside the window.

round_index.description: Index into rounds[] of the round containing t_peak_s, or null.

target.description: Estimated target level, or null if not estimated.

device_id.description: Since 1.1.0: device that detected the event (session.devices[].device_id). Whole-body events seen by both sensors (kick_or_body_movement, clinch) are merged and keep the device with the larger peak.

punches.description: All detected events (strikes, kick_or_body_movement and clinch), sorted by t_peak_s. Array name kept for compatibility.

punch_count.description: Strike events only (every type except kick_or_body_movement and clinch).

punches_per_min.description: Over active (round) time if rounds exist, else whole session.

punches_per_round.description: One entry per rounds[] item with kind == round, in order.

by_type.description: Counts per type, including the non-strike types.

by_hand.description: Punch events only, keyed L, R, unknown (hand null).

saturated_sample_fraction.description: Fraction of raw samples with sat = 1.

non_punch_count.description: Optional. Count of kick_or_body_movement + clinch events.

by_target.description: Optional. Punch events by target; null target counted as unknown.

clinch_time_s.description: Optional. Total duration of clinch events.
